statement_html:
Let \(f: \RR \rightarrow \RR\) be a bijective function, and let \(A\) be a bounded subset of \(\displaystyle{\RR}\). Consider the image B=(A) and the inverse image \(C=f^{-1}(A)\) of \(A\).

What can be said about \(B\) and \(C\)?

You must choose the most precise replies.

answers.expected: not necessarily bounded from either side
